FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Upholstery Pros, we specialize in providing high-quality upholstery services for both residential and commercial clients. Our core operations include repairing, cleaning, and reupholstering furniture items such as sofas, chairs, and office suites, ensuring each piece meets our rigorous standards for quality and craftsmanship. Our skilled team members are trained in the latest upholstery techniques, including fabric handling and repair, which enables us to provide exceptional service and maintain client satisfaction. We adhere to industry standards by using only top-quality materials and equipment, which minimizes the risk of any service-related issues. Safety is paramount; therefore, we implement documented safety protocols for handling chemicals and machinery. Our team is also committed to continuous improvement through regular training and customer feedback mechanisms, allowing us to enhance our service offerings. Through our mobile upholstery services, we are equipped with comprehensive commercial auto insurance to cover our operations while on-site at client locations. We strive to maintain a secure inventory and uphold compliance with local regulations, facilitating a reliable and professional service experience for our customers.

Our team specializes in upholstery services, where we undertake various tasks such as fabric handling, cleaning, and repair of furniture, with staff leveraging their hands-on experience to deliver quality results.
